title: Awakening
arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُوْرُ
translation: Praise is to Allah who gave us life after death and to Him is the return.

title: Morning Dhikr
arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلّٰهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ
translation: We have entered the morning and all dominion belongs to Allah, and all praise is to Allah.

title: Dua for Guidance
translation: O Allah, guide me and keep me steadfast.

title: Before Sleeping
translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

title: Evening Protection
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief.

title: Entering Mosque
translation: O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.

title: Leaving Mosque
translation: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty.

title: Before Eating
translation: In the name of Allah.

title: After Eating
translation: All praise is for Allah who fed us and gave us drink.

title: Before Travel
translation: Glory to Him who provided this transport for us.

title: Dua for Forgiveness
translation: My Lord, forgive me.

title: Protection from Evil Eye
translation: I seek refuge in Allah's perfect words.

title: Dua for Parents
translation: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they raised me when small.

title: Dua for Rizq
translation: O Allah, I ask You for pure sustenance.

title: Dua After Salah
translation: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace.

title: When in Distress
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
translation: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

title: Entering Home
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلِجِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ
translation: O Allah, I ask You for the best of entry and the best of exit.

title: Leaving Home
translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah.

title: Before Wudu
translation: In the name of Allah.

title: After Wudu
arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
translation: I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger.

title: Dua for Knowledge
translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

title: Dua for Patience
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from incapacity and laziness.

title: Dua for Health
translation: O Allah, grant me health in my body.

title: Dua for Wealth
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
translation: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and self-sufficiency.

title: Dua for Marriage
translation: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous.

title: Dua for Children
arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي
translation: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants.

title: Dua for Anxiety
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry, grief, incapacity, and laziness.

title: Dua for Depression
translation: O Allah, I am Your slave, son of Your slave.

title: Dua for Death
translation: O Allah, forgive me and have mercy on me.

title: Dua for Rain
translation: O Allah, give us saving rain.

title: Dua for Wind
translation: O Allah, I ask You for its good.

title: Dua for Thunder
translation: Glorified is He Whom thunder and angels praise.

title: Dua for New Moon
translation: O Allah, let this moon appear on us with security and faith.

title: Dua for Travel Safety
translation: O Allah, make this journey easy for us.

title: Dua When Boarding Vehicle
arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ
translation: Glory to Him Who has subjected this to us, and we could never have it (by our efforts).

title: Dua for Sick Person
arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
translation: I ask Allah the Almighty, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, to heal you.

title: Dua When Visiting Sick
arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
translation: Do not worry, it is a purification (for you) if Allah wills.

title: Dua for Fear
translation: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.

title: Dua for Gratitude
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, thank You, and worship You properly.

title: Dua for Repentance
arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي
translation: My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me.

title: Dua for Good Ending
translation: O Allah, make the best of my life the last of it.

title: Dua for Protection from Hell
translation: O Allah, protect me from the Hellfire.

title: Dua for Paradise
translation: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise.

title: Dua During Ramadan
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ صُمْتُ وَعَلَى رِزْقِكَ أَفْطَرْتُ
translation: O Allah, for You I have fasted, and with Your provision I break my fast.

title: Dua for Laylatul Qadr
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
translation: O Allah, indeed You are Pardoning, You love pardon, so pardon me.

title: Dua for Eid
translation: May Allah accept (good deeds) from us and from you.

title: Dua for Hajj Talbiyah
translation: Here I am, O Allah, here I am.

title: Dua at Arafat
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
translation: There is no deity but Allah alone, with no partner.

title: Dua for Friday
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ
translation: O Allah, forgive me my past and future sins.

title: Dua for Sleep
translation: In Your name, my Lord, I lie down.

title: Dua for Morning
translation: We have awakened upon the natural disposition of Islam.

title: Dua for Evening
translation: We have entered the evening and all dominion belongs to Allah.

title: Dua Before Knowledge
translation: O Allah, benefit me with what You have taught me.

title: Dua for Increase in Rizq
translation: O Allah, suffice me with what is lawful instead of what is unlawful.

title: Dua When Sneezing
translation: All praise is for Allah.

title: Reply to Sneezing
translation: May Allah have mercy on you.

title: Dua After Replying Sneezing
translation: May Allah guide you and set your affairs right.

title: Dua for Entering Toilet
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from evil and evil-doers.

title: Dua for Leaving Toilet
translation: I seek Your forgiveness.

title: Dua Before Studying
translation: My Lord, expand for me my chest.

title: Dua for Ease
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا
translation: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy.

title: Dua When Angry
translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Shaytan, the accursed.

title: Dua for Good Character
translation: O Allah, beautify my character.

title: Dua for Success
translation: My Lord, grant me success in what You love and are pleased with.

title: Dua Before Exam
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا
translation: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy.

title: Dua After Exam
translation: All praise is for Allah in every situation.

title: Dua When Afraid
translation: O Allah, protect me from them however You will.

title: Dua for Strong Iman
translation: O Allah, keep my heart firm upon Your religion.

title: Dua for Protection of Children
translation: I seek protection for you in Allah’s perfect words.

title: Dua When Wearing Clothes
translation: Praise is to Allah who clothed me with this.

title: Dua for New Clothes
translation: O Allah, praise is Yours, You have clothed me with it.

title: Dua When Looking in Mirror
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِي
translation: O Allah, just as You made my appearance good, make my character good.

title: Dua for Entering Market
translation: There is no deity but Allah alone.

title: Dua When Hearing Good News
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
translation: Praise be to Allah by whose favor good deeds are completed.

title: Dua When Hearing Bad News
translation: Indeed we belong to Allah and to Him we return.

title: Dua for Rain Stopping
translation: O Allah, around us and not upon us.

title: Dua for Blessing in Time
translation: O Allah, bless my time.

title: Dua for Protection at Night
arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
translation: I seek refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil of what He created.

title: Dua for Relief from Debt
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from sin and debt.

title: Dua for Forgiveness Morning and Evening
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You.

title: Dua for Entering Prayer
translation: O Allah, distance me from my sins as You have distanced the East from the West.

title: Opening Supplication in Salah
translation: Glory and praise are Yours, O Allah.

title: Dua in Ruku
translation: Glory is to my Lord, the Most Great.

title: Dua in Sujood
translation: Glory is to my Lord, the Most High.

title: Dua Between Sujood
translation: My Lord, forgive me and have mercy on me.

title: Tashahhud
translation: All greetings, prayers, and good deeds are for Allah.

title: Salawat on Prophet
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.

title: Dua After Tashahhud
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of Hell.

title: Dua for Parents Forgiveness
translation: My Lord, forgive me and my parents.

title: Dua for Mercy
translation: My Lord, have mercy on me with vast mercy.

title: Dua for Barakah in Wealth
translation: O Allah, bless my provision.

title: Dua for Halal Earnings
translation: O Allah, make my sustenance lawful and pure.

title: Dua for Protection from Shirk
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from associating partners with You.

title: Dua for Protection from Hypocrisy
translation: O Allah, purify my heart from hypocrisy.

title: Dua for Contentment
translation: O Allah, make me among those who are content.

title: Dua for Good Company
translation: O Allah, grant me the companionship of the righteous.

title: Dua for Protection from Bad Friends
translation: O Allah, keep bad companions away from me.

title: Dua for Strength
translation: O Allah, strengthen me in obeying You.

title: Dua for Sincerity
translation: O Allah, make my deeds sincere for Your sake.

title: Dua for Protection from Pride
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكِبْرِ
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from arrogance.

title: Dua for Humility
translation: O Allah, make me among the humble.

title: Dua for Protection from Sin
translation: O Allah, protect me from sins.

title: Dua for Strong Memory
translation: O Allah, strengthen my memory.

title: Dua for Understanding
translation: O Allah, grant me understanding in religion.

title: Dua for Wisdom
translation: O Allah, grant me wisdom.

title: Dua for Peace of Heart
translation: O Allah, place tranquility in my heart.

title: Dua for Protection from Anxiety
translation: O Allah, remove my worries.

title: Dua for Healing Heart
translation: O Allah, heal my chest (heart).

title: Dua for Protection from Harm
translation: O Allah, protect me from every evil.

title: Dua for Safe Journey
translation: O Allah, protect us in our journey.

title: Dua for Returning Home
translation: We return, repent, and worship our Lord.

title: Dua for Blessing in Home
translation: O Allah, bless our homes.

title: Dua for Safety of Family
translation: O Allah, protect my family.

title: Dua for Good Children
translation: O Allah, make my children righteous.

title: Dua for Love Between Spouses
translation: O Allah, unite our hearts in love.

title: Dua for Removing Hardship
translation: O Allah, remove hardship from me.

title: Dua for Protection from Disease
translation: O Allah, protect me from diseases.

title: Dua for Long Life in Obedience
translation: O Allah, make my life full of goodness.

title: Dua for Good Deeds
translation: O Allah, grant me success in righteous deeds.

title: Dua for Acceptance of Deeds
translation: O Allah, accept from me.

title: Dua for Protection from Fire
translation: O Allah, save me from the Fire.

title: Dua for Jannah
translation: O Allah, admit me into Paradise.

title: Dua for Protection from Punishment
translation: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment.

title: Dua for Light in Grave
translation: O Allah, illuminate my grave.

title: Dua for Easy Death
translation: O Allah, ease for me the pains of death.

title: Dua for Good Judgment Day
translation: O Allah, make my reckoning easy.

title: Dua for Shade on Day of Judgment
translation: O Allah, shade me under Your shade.

title: Dua for Meeting Allah
translation: O Allah, make meeting You good for me.

title: Dua for Forgiveness of All Sins
translation: O Allah, forgive me all of my sins.

title: Dua for Mercy on Judgment Day
translation: O Allah, have mercy on me on the Day of Resurrection.
